I posted a reply in #strategic-pod to June, but I didn't set up the recurring 'Pod end of day' note.

This session has no way to schedule a post into Slack. Scheduled jobs created here are local-only and don't deliver back into this channel. So nothing will post at 17:30 on weekdays.

The reply tells June I haven't scheduled anything. It offers to post a 'Pod end of day' summary here on request each day, or suggests someone with a workspace scheduler set one up. Message ts is 1791986400.000127.
